responsibility: Defines the rs6000 target adjustments for AIX 6.1. In addition to the common AIX settings, it handles 64-bit and code-model option validation, large-TOC/cmodel policy, updated assembler CPU defaults and VSX handling, AIX 6.1 predefined macros, modern startup/link/library specs, default POWER7 tuning, and enabling Altivec/VSX OS support for this release.
